name: 11222 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11222 (Brooklyn) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11222 (Brooklyn) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11222 (Brooklyn) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).
